skill.description: Query and maintain verified creator identities, rates, rights, exclusivity, compliance events, and performance facts through an append-only event registry.
skill.summary: Maintain a traceable creator roster with verified facts, proposal decisions, and revision history.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, fixed repository links, metadata URLs, and safe error redirection. The skill does execute local commands, and its unquoted creator identifier creates a plausible command-injection risk when derived from user input.

remediation.issue: The creator aggregate identifier is shown as an unquoted shell argument.
remediation.suggestion: Validate the identifier against a strict allowlist and pass it as a quoted argument without shell interpolation.

remediation.issue: Repository-root discovery uses shell command substitution before invoking a local registry script.
remediation.suggestion: Use a host-provided trusted root, verify the resolved script path, and invoke commands through structured argument arrays.

content.value_statement: Creator facts often become inconsistent across campaigns, contracts, and platforms. This skill maintains a traceable registry with verified sources, revisions, and proposal decisions.
actual_capabilities: Queries current creator records by aggregate identifier.
Records verified rates, rights, exclusivity, and campaign baselines.
Reviews pending proposals and records acceptance or rejection decisions.
Preserves event provenance, revisions, conflicts, and source dates.
Deduplicates handles using verified cross-links or user confirmation.
Generates human-readable creator views from accepted projection state.
limitations: Requires the repository runtime, schemas, catalog, and host capabilities for canonical writes.
Does not score creator fit, calculate ROI, judge compliance, or choose partners.
Cannot confirm identity from similar names or handles alone.
Standalone installations can prepare proposals but cannot claim canonical registry state.

use_cases.title: Review Creator History
use_cases.description: Retrieve current rates, rights, exclusivity, and dated campaign baselines before planning a new collaboration.

use_cases.title: Reconcile Pending Updates
use_cases.description: Compare proposed creator facts with accepted state, then document acceptance, rejection, or conflicts.

use_cases.title: Maintain Auditable Records
use_cases.description: Record closed campaign terms and outcomes with source dates, revisions, and event identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Creator Record
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the current verified rate, rights, and exclusivity facts for creator [aggregate ID]. Include source dates and unknown fields.

prompt_templates.title: Record a Campaign Outcome
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a proposal for creator [aggregate ID] using this closed campaign evidence: [details]. Preserve source, date, window, and measurement unit.

prompt_templates.title: Review Pending Proposals
prompt_templates.prompt: Review pending proposals for creator [aggregate ID] in offset order. Compare each with accepted state and recommend acceptance or rejection with reasons.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Conflicting Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Reconcile these sources for creator [aggregate ID]: [sources]. Compare matching fields and units, preserve conflicts, and prepare authorized registry decisions.

output: Proposal 104: accept. It matches signed terms and uses the current revision.
Proposal 107: reject. Its rights period conflicts with stronger dated contract evidence.

output_examples.input: Merge these two similar creator handles.
output_examples.output: The handles remain separate because name similarity is insufficient. Provide a verified cross-link, matching contact evidence, or explicit user confirmation.

best_practices: Use pseudonymous aggregate identifiers and retain only collaboration facts that have a clear purpose.
Confirm authorization before persistent writes and preserve every proposal decision in the append-only stream.
Compare evidence only when fields, units, and observation windows match.
anti_patterns: Do not store raw contact details, credentials, or unnecessary personal history.
Do not treat pending proposals or generated Markdown views as canonical state.
Do not merge identities from similar names, handles, or reputation assumptions.

faq.question: Can this skill choose creators for a campaign?
faq.answer: No. It records creator facts and provenance but does not score fit or select partners.

faq.question: Can it update the canonical registry?
faq.answer: Yes, when the verified runtime and required host capability are available. Otherwise, it can only prepare proposals.

faq.question: How does it handle conflicting sources?
faq.answer: It compares matching fields and units, preserves both source events, and records the adjudication rationale.

faq.question: Does it store personal contact information?
faq.answer: It should not store raw email, phone, postal address, credentials, or unnecessary personal history.

faq.question: Can it recover deleted creator records?
faq.answer: It checks prior erasure state before recreation and requires explicit authorization plus a lawful basis.

faq.question: What information appears in generated creator views?
faq.answer: Views contain accepted identity links, commercial facts, baselines, compliance events, decisions, and source revision details.
